description: The plot illustrates the relationship between input image size and harmful refusal ratio for different vision-language models. The x-axis represents input image size, labeled as “Image Size”, with a linear scale ranging from 128 to 1024, in units of pixels, and tick labels at intervals of 128. The y-axis represents “Harmful Refusal Ratio”, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1.  A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep, starting at a value of approximately 0.21 at an image size of 128 and increasing to approximately 0.33 at an image size of 1024. An orange line, marked with square data points, represents Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep, beginning at approximately 0.28 at an image size of 128 and rising to approximately 0.42 at an image size of 1024. A green line, marked with triangular data points, represents LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench, starting at approximately 0.18 at an image size of 128 and increasing to approximately 0.36 at an image size of 1024. A red line, marked with diamond data points, represents Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench, beginning at approximately 0.24 at an image size of 128 and rising to approximately 0.41 at an image size of 1024.
